plugins.photosPermission: Happy Orange uses your photos to estimate the nutrition of your meals.
plugins.cameraPermission: Happy Orange uses the camera to photograph your meals and estimate their nutrition.

plugins.NSHealthShareUsageDescription: Happy Orange reads your steps, exercise minutes and sleep from Apple Health, so your Body score fills in without typing.
plugins.NSHealthUpdateUsageDescription: Happy Orange does not write to Apple Health today. If a future version saves anything, such as a meditation session, it will ask you first.

plugins.microphonePermission: Happy Orange listens only while you tap Speak, so you can say what you ate.
plugins.speechRecognitionPermission: Happy Orange turns what you say about your meal into text to work out its nutrition.
